test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: David has two grandsons Rodney and Amit. 15 year old Rodney gets some money from David’s wealth and 16 year old Amit gets rest of the money. But Rodney and Amit will get money only when they turn 22 years old. Till then the money is in a bank getting interest at rate 8% compounded annually. When both turn 22, they receive the same amount. How much had David given Amit (in ₹) initially, if total money with David was ₹23400 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for Rodney = 22 − 15 = 7 years and Time for Amit = 22 − 16 = 6 years.

Time difference = 1 year. Since Amit's money compounds for 1 year less, his principal must be larger by the 1-year interest multiplier.

Ratio of shares (Amit : Rodney) = (100 + 8) : 100 = 108 : 100 = 27 : 25.

Total ratio parts = 27 + 25 = 52 parts → ₹23400.

Amit's share (27 parts) = (23400 ÷ 52) × 27 = 450 × 27 = ₹12150.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12150.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 Total Wealth = ₹23400
